result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverages, limits, the data-processing condition for cyber/privacy coverage, legally required workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. However, requiring every policy to remain in place for one year after termination exceeds the playbook and is not narrowly tailored, particularly for occurrence-based CGL and workers’ compensation. Drafting is otherwise serviceable, but section 14.10 is placed after renumbered section 14.11, and “Corio or Customer data” should align with the defined term “Customer Data.” The unrelated bankruptcy and integration provisions are substantively preserved.
